name: select
description: Single-option selector with an input-like trigger and a floating panel below it, matching Combobox.
example:
import { Select } from '@/components/stepwise/select'

const options = [
  { value: 'next',    label: 'Next.js' },
  { value: 'remix',   label: 'Remix' },
  { value: 'astro',   label: 'Astro' },
]

<Select options={options} placeholder="Choose a framework" />
